headline: Shutong Hou and Chang Liu surge into ARC-3 top 100

sections.text: Shutong Hou climbed from 3610th to 66th at 33.05, while chang liu rose from 1172nd to 41st at 33.47.
Both moves put the teams inside the top 100. The ARC-3 gold line is 36.14 at 18th, so the climbs reshape the chase below the medal places.
